scope: The playable A lineup establishes finish and detail scale. Individually approved concepts supply mechanical construction references.
reviewCriteria: Color and value: check for coherent blocks of chassis paint, dark mechanisms and a small visor accent against the playable lineup.
Armor construction: broad facets and selective bevels describe the main volumes in the Mech Bay view.
Detail scale: compare at Practice range size. The cockpit, stance and fitted weapon housings remain legible without fine texture.
Joints and interfaces: reinforced load-bearing pivots, protected waist connections and functional weapon attachments share the same industrial construction language.
Distinct chassis identity: preserve the requested role, silhouette, cockpit, leg anatomy, proportions and legal mounts; do not copy another reference chassis or blend their equipment.
